Seventh, inflation erodes the real value of both your mortgage debt and your savings over time. Eighth, compound interest means early investments grow more. Ninth, you might want to split — some toward the mortgage, some toward investing. Tenth, consider speaking to a financial adviser for a personal recommendation.
